description: This file defines the BankClearance class with methods to retrieve and update payment entries related to bank clearance, including SQL queries for fetching journal, payment, sales, and purchase invoice data, and logic for updating clearance dates.

classes.name: BankClearance
classes.description: Represents a bank clearance document with methods to fetch and update payment entries and clearance dates.

methods.name: get_payment_entries
methods.description: Fetches payment, journal, sales, and purchase invoice entries within a date range and updates the payment_entries list.

methods.name: update_clearance_date
methods.description: Updates the clearance date for selected payment entries and refreshes the entries list.
